# Draft:List of Mahishya Kingdoms and Dynasties

This is a list of Mahishya dynasties and Mahishya Kingdoms the Indian subcontinent.
*Bahubalindra Royal Family they ruled as a feudal vassal under the Gajapati Empire from 15th to 19th century.
*Turkagarh Royal Family they ruled in Khandruigarh Estate from 16th to 17th centuries.
*Birkul Royal Family, they ruled in the Midnapore district and northern areas of Odisha from 16th to 18th centuries as feudal vassals under Mayurbhanj State.
